title: Strict decrease of odd majority noise stability
statement: For every correlation parameter $\rho$ with $0<\rho<1$, the noise stability of majority on $2m+1$ coordinates is strictly antitone as a function of $m\in\mathbb{N}$; that is, its value strictly decreases whenever $m$ increases.
